title: PLAN card frontmatter
description: Plan document. constellation/plan.md is PLAN-PROJECT; scoped plans (PLAN-FRONTEND) live in plan/. Keep plans short — decisions belong in DECISION cards, status on the cards themselves.

code_root.description: Folder whose code this plan describes, relative to the directory containing constellation/. Omit when the plan sits directly under its code root.

scope.description: Area this plan covers, e.g. frontend. Omit for the project plan.

doc_sections.description: Ordered documentation sections for the compiled document at /docs (declare on PLAN-PROJECT). Authored ordering, not derived state — membership is self-declared by each card's `section:`, and this only says what the sections are called and what order they read in. A slug used on cards but missing here is appended at the end, alphabetically, titled from the slug.

id.description: Section slug — the value cards carry as `section:`.

name.description: Display name, rendered as the section's heading.

summary.description: One line under the section heading, saying what the section covers.

connected_repos.description: Sibling repos this project coordinates with (declare on PLAN-PROJECT). Repo-level links only — NOT card connections; cards never reference another repo's cards. Each entry's path is local topology and is never validated by lint.

name.description: Lowercase id used as the `repo` selector in MCP tools (e.g. pyramid-server).

path.description: Path to the connected repo's root, relative to this repo's root (e.g. ../pyramid-server). May be absolute.

description.description: What the connected repo is, e.g. 'Back-end API for Pyramid, written in Go'.
